patterns.pattern: Low max rise before entry → loser
patterns.evidence: max_rise_so_far_pct median 5.6 % for losers vs 18.4 % for winners; mean 5.59 % vs 75.96 % (auc 0.412)

patterns.pattern: Low active share and short active time → loser
patterns.evidence: active_share median 0.625 vs 0.857 (loser mean 0.594, winner mean 0.747); active_secs median 5 s vs 6 s (loser mean 4.70, winner mean 5.57)
volume_last5_vs_before median 0.332 vs 0.357 (loser mean 10.38, winner mean 2.06; auc 0.482)
volatility_pct median 5.41 % vs 14.57 % (loser mean 10.19, winner mean 16.48; auc 0.328)

patterns.pattern: Less drop from recent high → loser
patterns.evidence: drop_from_high_pct median –1.97 % vs –10.47 % (loser mean –11.48, winner mean –19.29; auc 0.601)

dont_buy_rules.name: low_max_rise_and_low_activity
dont_buy_rules.why: Losers have median max rise ≈ 5 % (vs ≈ 18 % for winners) and lower activity (active_share ≈ 0.63, active_secs ≈ 5 s). This rule would have avoided 355 losers (≈ 47 % of all losers) while only discarding 310 winners (≈ 24 % of winners), saving 2 473 pnl‑pts at the cost of 25 586 pnl‑pts.

dont_buy_rules.name: low_vol_and_low_volume_spike
dont_buy_rules.why: Losers are less volatile (median ≈ 5 % vs ≈ 14 % for winners) and have a smaller recent volume surge (median ≈ 0.33 vs ≈ 0.36). This rule would have avoided 91 losers (≈ 12 % of losers) while only losing 30 winners (≈ 2 %); it saved 572 pnl‑pts but gave up 1 548 pnl‑pts.

dont_buy_rules.name: short_time_since_launch_low_volume
dont_buy_rules.why: Tokens launched longer ago with low total volume tend to be losers (91 avoided, 30 winners lost). This rule captures a small but clean slice of the loss space.

wait_advice: Wait about 20 seconds after launch before sending the buy order. At a 20 s delay the loser share is 47 % and the average best P&L is ≈ 77 pts (higher than at 30 s or 60 s). Longer waits increase the loser share and reduce average P&L.
caveat: These patterns and rules are derived from a single day of launch data (≈ 2 500 tokens). Market dynamics, launch formats, and token‑specific events can differ, so a rule that blocks many losers may also filter out a sizable fraction of winners. Continuous re‑evaluation on fresh data is required before deploying any rule in production.
